title: Shortest Round Trip
statement:
A courier must visit all `n` cities exactly once and then return to city `1`, which is where the trip starts. The cost of going from city `i` to city `j` is `c[i][j]`; the costs need not be symmetric, so `c[i][j]` may differ from `c[j][i]`. Find the smallest total cost of such a round trip. With one city the cost is `0`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `n` integers, the row `c[i][1..n]`. The diagonal is `0`.

## Output
Print the smallest total cost.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 11`
- `1 <= c[i][j] <= 1000` for `i != j`
